English.simple: Newton's Third Law says that whenever one object applies a force on another object, the second object applies an equal force in the opposite direction.
steps: One object applies a force on another object.
The second object also applies a force back.
Both forces have the same magnitude.
The two forces act in opposite directions.
The forces act on two different objects.
English.analogy: It is like pushing a wall. You push the wall, and the wall pushes back on your hand with an equal force.

Telugu.simple: Newton's Third Law prakaram, oka object vere object meeda force apply chesthe, second object kuda equal force ni opposite direction lo apply chestundi.
steps: Oka object vere object meeda force apply chestundi.
Second object kuda force ni back apply chestundi.
Rendu forces magnitude equal ga untayi.
Rendu forces opposite directions lo untayi.
Aa forces rendu different objects meeda act chestayi.
Telugu.analogy: Idi wall ni push cheyyadam laantidi. Manam wall ni push chesthe, wall kuda mana hand meeda equal force tho back push chestundi.

Hindi.simple: Newton's Third Law kehta hai ki jab ek object doosre object par force lagata hai, to doosra object bhi equal force opposite direction mein lagata hai.
steps: Ek object doosre object par force lagata hai.
Doosra object bhi force ko wapas apply karta hai.
Dono forces ki magnitude equal hoti hai.
Dono forces opposite directions mein hoti hain.
Dono forces different objects par act karti hain.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh wall ko push karne jaisa hai. Jab hum wall ko push karte hain, wall bhi hamare hand par equal force se push back karti hai.

English.simple: Volcanoes and earthquakes are natural events caused mainly by movements and changes inside the Earth's crust.
steps: Earth's outer layer is divided into tectonic plates.
These plates slowly move over time.
Plate movements can build up pressure.
Sudden release of this pressure can cause earthquakes.
Magma reaching the surface through openings can cause volcanic eruptions.
English.analogy: It is like pieces of a giant puzzle moving against each other. When pressure builds up and suddenly releases, the ground can shake.

Telugu.simple: Volcanoes mariyu earthquakes Earth crust lopala jarige movements mariyu changes valla mainly occur ayye natural events.
steps: Earth outer layer tectonic plates ga divide ayi untundi.
Ee plates slow ga move avutayi.
Plate movements valla pressure build avvachu.
Aa pressure sudden ga release ayithe earthquake ravachu.
Magma surface ki openings dwara vasthe volcanic eruption jaragachu.
Telugu.analogy: Idi giant puzzle pieces okadanito okati move avvadam laantidi. Pressure ekkuva ayyi sudden ga release ayithe ground shake avvachu.

Hindi.simple: Volcanoes aur earthquakes natural events hain jo mainly Earth ki crust ke andar movements aur changes ki wajah se hote hain.
steps: Earth ki outer layer tectonic plates mein divided hoti hai.
Yeh plates dheere dheere move karti hain.
Plate movements ki wajah se pressure build ho sakta hai.
Pressure suddenly release hone par earthquake aa sakta hai.
Magma openings ke through surface par aaye to volcanic eruption ho sakta hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh ek giant puzzle ke pieces ke ek doosre ke against move karne jaisa hai. Pressure build hokar suddenly release ho to ground shake ho sakti hai.

English.simple: Reflection is the bouncing back of light when it strikes a surface.
steps: Light travels from a source toward a surface.
The light reaches the surface.
Some or all of the light bounces back.
The reflected light travels toward our eyes.
Our brain interprets the reflected light and we see the object.
English.analogy: It is like a ball bouncing back after hitting a wall. Light also bounces back when it hits a suitable surface.

Telugu.simple: Reflection ante light oka surface ni hit chesinappudu back ki bounce avvadam.
steps: Light source nundi surface vaipu travel avutundi.
Light surface ni reach avutundi.
Light lo kontha leda motham part back ki bounce avutundi.
Reflected light mana eyes vaipu travel avutundi.
Mana brain reflected light ni process chesi object ni chustundi.
Telugu.analogy: Idi wall ki ball ni throw chesthe ball back ki bounce avvadam laantidi. Light kuda suitable surface ni hit chesthe back ki bounce avutundi.

Hindi.simple: Reflection ka matlab hai light ka kisi surface se takrakar wapas bounce hona.
steps: Light source se surface ki taraf travel karti hai.
Light surface tak pahunchti hai.
Light ka kuch ya poora part wapas bounce hota hai.
Reflected light hamari eyes ki taraf travel karti hai.
Hamari brain reflected light ko process karke object ko dekhta hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh wall se ball bounce hone jaisa hai. Light bhi suitable surface se takrakar wapas bounce hoti hai.

English.simple: Magnetism is a force that allows magnets to attract or repel certain materials and other magnets.
steps: A magnet has a magnetic field around it.
The magnetic field can exert forces on magnetic materials.
Opposite magnetic poles attract each other.
Like magnetic poles repel each other.
Magnetism is used in many devices such as motors, speakers, and generators.
English.analogy: It is like an invisible force field around a magnet that can pull or push other magnetic objects.

Telugu.simple: Magnetism ante magnets konni materials ni mariyu vere magnets ni attract leda repel cheyyadaniki allow chese force.
steps: Magnet chuttu magnetic field untundi.
Ee magnetic field magnetic materials meeda force apply cheyyagaladu.
Opposite magnetic poles okadanini okati attract chestayi.
Same magnetic poles okadanini okati repel chestayi.
Motors, speakers mariyu generators lanti devices lo magnetism use chestaru.
Telugu.analogy: Idi magnet chuttu unna invisible force field laantidi. Adi vere magnetic objects ni pull leda push cheyyagaladu.

Hindi.simple: Magnetism ek force hai jo magnets ko kuch materials aur doosre magnets ko attract ya repel karne mein help karti hai.
steps: Magnet ke around magnetic field hota hai.
Magnetic field magnetic materials par force laga sakta hai.
Opposite magnetic poles ek doosre ko attract karte hain.
Same magnetic poles ek doosre ko repel karte hain.
Motors, speakers aur generators jaise devices mein magnetism use hota hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh magnet ke around ek invisible force field jaisa hai jo doosre magnetic objects ko pull ya push kar sakta hai.

English.simple: Equality means giving every person equal rights, opportunities, and respect regardless of their background.
steps: Every person should have equal basic rights.
People should get fair opportunities.
Discrimination can prevent people from getting equal opportunities.
Respect should be given to everyone.
Fair treatment helps create an inclusive society.
English.analogy: It is like giving every student the same chance to participate in a race instead of choosing winners based on their background.

Telugu.simple: Equality ante person's background tho sambandham lekunda andariki equal rights, opportunities mariyu respect ivvadam.
steps: Prathi person ki equal basic rights undali.
Andariki fair opportunities dorakali.
Discrimination valla equal opportunities miss avvachu.
Prathi okkariki respect ivvali.
Fair treatment inclusive society ni create cheyyadaniki help chestundi.
Telugu.analogy: Idi race lo prathi student ki same chance ivvadam laantidi. Background batti winner ni decide cheyyakudadhu.

Hindi.simple: Equality ka matlab hai har person ko unke background ki parwah kiye bina equal rights, opportunities aur respect dena.
steps: Har person ko equal basic rights milne chahiye.
Sabko fair opportunities milni chahiye.
Discrimination ki wajah se equal opportunities nahi mil sakti hain.
Har person ko respect dena chahiye.
Fair treatment ek inclusive society banane mein help karta hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh race mein har student ko same chance dene jaisa hai, na ki unke background ke basis par winner choose karna.

English.simple: Climate change is the long-term change in Earth's temperatures and weather patterns, largely influenced today by human activities.
steps: Human activities release greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
Greenhouse gases trap heat around Earth.
More trapped heat can increase global temperatures.
Changing temperatures can affect weather patterns and ecosystems.
Reducing emissions and using cleaner energy can help reduce the impact.
English.analogy: It is like adding extra layers to a blanket around Earth. More layers can trap more heat.

Telugu.simple: Climate change ante Earth temperatures mariyu weather patterns lo long-term changes. Present time lo human activities kuda important role play chestunnayi.
steps: Human activities valla greenhouse gases atmosphere loki release avutayi.
Greenhouse gases Earth chuttu heat ni trap chestayi.
Ekkuva heat trap avvadam valla global temperatures increase avvachu.
Temperature changes weather patterns mariyu ecosystems ni affect cheyyachu.
Emissions reduce cheyyadam mariyu clean energy use cheyyadam impact ni tagginchadaniki help chestayi.
Telugu.analogy: Idi Earth chuttu extra blanket layers add cheyyadam laantidi. Ekkuva layers ekkuva heat ni trap chestayi.

Hindi.simple: Climate change ka matlab Earth ke temperatures aur weather patterns mein long-term changes hain, jin par aaj human activities ka bhi important effect hai.
steps: Human activities ki wajah se greenhouse gases atmosphere mein release hoti hain.
Greenhouse gases Earth ke around heat ko trap karti hain.
Zyada heat trap hone se global temperatures increase ho sakte hain.
Temperature changes weather patterns aur ecosystems ko affect kar sakte hain.
Emissions reduce karna aur clean energy use karna impact ko kam karne mein help karta hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh Earth ke around extra blanket layers add karne jaisa hai. Zyada layers zyada heat trap karti hain.

English.simple: Artificial Intelligence is the ability of computer systems to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding, learning, and decision-making.
steps: Data is collected and provided to an AI system.
The system processes the data using algorithms or models.
It identifies patterns or useful information.
The system uses what it learned to make predictions or decisions.
The result is provided to the user or another system.
English.analogy: It is like teaching a student using many examples. After learning the patterns, the student can use them to answer new questions.

Telugu.simple: Artificial Intelligence ante computers human intelligence avasaram ayye tasks ni perform cheyyagalige technology, like understanding, learning mariyu decision-making.
steps: Data ni collect chesi AI system ki provide chestaru.
System algorithms leda models use chesi data ni process chestundi.
System patterns mariyu useful information ni identify chestundi.
Learn chesina information ni use cheskoni predictions leda decisions chestundi.
Result ni user ki leda vere system ki provide chestundi.
Telugu.analogy: Idi student ki chala examples tho teaching cheyyadam laantidi. Patterns nerchukunna tarvata student new questions ki answer cheyyagaladu.

Hindi.simple: Artificial Intelligence ek technology hai jisme computer systems human intelligence ki zarurat wale tasks perform kar sakte hain, jaise understanding, learning aur decision-making.
steps: Data collect karke AI system ko diya jata hai.
System algorithms ya models ka use karke data process karta hai.
System patterns aur useful information identify karta hai.
Learn ki hui information ka use karke predictions ya decisions karta hai.
Result user ya kisi doosre system ko diya jata hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh ek student ko bahut saare examples se teach karne jaisa hai. Patterns seekhne ke baad student new questions ka answer de sakta hai.

English.simple: Robotics is the field of designing, building, programming, and controlling robots to perform tasks.
steps: A robot is designed for a specific task.
Sensors collect information from the environment.
A controller or computer processes the information.
The robot decides or follows programmed actions.
Motors and other components perform the physical action.
English.analogy: A robot is like a body with sensors as eyes and ears, a controller as the brain, and motors as muscles.

Telugu.simple: Robotics ante tasks perform cheyyadaniki robots ni design, build, program mariyu control chese field.
steps: Specific task kosam robot ni design chestaru.
Sensors environment nundi information collect chestayi.
Controller leda computer information ni process chestundi.
Robot programmed actions ni follow chestundi leda decision teesukuntundi.
Motors mariyu other components physical action perform chestayi.
Telugu.analogy: Robot ni body la imagine cheyyachu. Sensors eyes and ears laga, controller brain laga, motors muscles laga work chestayi.

Hindi.simple: Robotics ek field hai jisme tasks perform karne ke liye robots ko design, build, program aur control kiya jata hai.
steps: Specific task ke liye robot ko design kiya jata hai.
Sensors environment se information collect karte hain.
Controller ya computer information ko process karta hai.
Robot programmed actions follow karta hai ya decision leta hai.
Motors aur doosre components physical action perform karte hain.
Hindi.analogy: Robot ko ek body ki tarah samajh sakte hain. Sensors eyes aur ears, controller brain aur motors muscles ki tarah kaam karte hain.

English.simple: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make their own food and release oxygen.
steps: Plants absorb water from the soil through their roots.
Leaves take in carbon dioxide from the air.
Chlorophyll in the leaves captures sunlight energy.
The plant uses sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make glucose (food).
Oxygen is released into the air as a by-product.
English.analogy: It is like a kitchen where sunlight provides the energy, water and carbon dioxide are the ingredients, and the plant's leaves act like the kitchen.

Telugu.simple: Photosynthesis ante green plants sunlight, water mariyu carbon dioxide ni use cheskoni own food prepare cheskune process. Ee process lo oxygen release avutundi.
steps: Plants roots dwara soil nundi water ni absorb chestayi.
Leaves air nundi carbon dioxide ni teesukuntayi.
Leaves lo unna chlorophyll sunlight energy ni capture chestundi.
Plant sunlight, water mariyu carbon dioxide ni use cheskoni glucose ane food ni prepare chestundi.
Oxygen by-product ga air loki release avutundi.
Telugu.analogy: Idi oka kitchen laantidi. Sunlight energy laga work chestundi, water mariyu carbon dioxide ingredients laga untayi, leaves kitchen laga work chestayi.

Hindi.simple: Photosynthesis woh process hai jisme green plants sunlight, water aur carbon dioxide ka use karke apna food banate hain aur oxygen release karte hain.
steps: Plants apni roots ke through soil se water absorb karte hain.
Leaves air se carbon dioxide lete hain.
Leaves mein chlorophyll sunlight ki energy ko capture karta hai.
Plant sunlight, water aur carbon dioxide ka use karke glucose yani food banata hai.
Oxygen by-product ke roop mein air mein release hota hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh ek kitchen ki tarah hai. Sunlight energy ka kaam karti hai, water aur carbon dioxide ingredients hain, aur leaves kitchen ki tarah kaam karte hain.

English.simple: An electric circuit is a closed path through which electric current can flow.
steps: A source such as a battery provides electrical energy.
Wires provide a path for current to travel.
Components such as bulbs or motors use electrical energy.
The circuit must form a closed path for continuous current flow.
Opening the circuit breaks the path and stops the current.
English.analogy: It is like water flowing through a closed pipe. The battery acts like a pump, wires act like pipes, and components use the energy.

Telugu.simple: Electric circuit ante electric current flow avvadaniki closed path.
steps: Battery lanti source electrical energy provide chestundi.
Wires current travel avvadaniki path provide chestayi.
Bulb leda motor lanti components electrical energy ni use chestayi.
Continuous current flow kosam circuit closed path ga undali.
Circuit open chesthe path break ayi current stop avutundi.
Telugu.analogy: Idi closed pipe lo water flow avvadam laantidi. Battery pump laga, wires pipes laga, components energy ni use chese parts laga work chestayi.

Hindi.simple: Electric circuit ek closed path hai jisme electric current flow kar sakta hai.
steps: Battery jaise source electrical energy provide karta hai.
Wires current ko travel karne ka path dete hain.
Bulb ya motor jaise components electrical energy use karte hain.
Continuous current flow ke liye circuit ka closed path hona zaroori hai.
Circuit open karne par path break hota hai aur current stop ho jata hai.
Hindi.analogy: Yeh closed pipe mein water flow hone jaisa hai. Battery pump ki tarah, wires pipes ki tarah aur components energy use karne wale parts ki tarah kaam karte hain.
